origin.description: A sentinel that means a key was not found. Printing it shows <Key Missing>.
origin.details: The object is an empty list with class key_missing. Two such objects are identical. Pass one as missing_default so a missing lookup is distinct from a stored NULL.
origin.example: x <- key_missing(); x; is.key_missing(x); identical(x, key_missing())

translation.description: A sentinel that means a key was not found. Printing it shows <Key Missing>.
translation.details: key_missing() returns a KeyMissing instance. Two sentinels compare equal. Pass one as missing_default so a missing lookup is distinct from a stored None.
translation.example:
from fastmap.key_missing import key_missing
from fastmap.is_key_missing import is_key_missing
x = key_missing()
print(x)
print(is_key_missing(x))
print(x == key_missing())
